description: One boat against the 10 closest published boats of the same type in the same country: specs and the all-in weekly price (EUR, at max guests, the figure search compares) for each of the next 52 weeks. Pass `id` (a boat), or `boat_type` and `country` (optionally `region`, `city`) to describe one. The specs take search_boats' names: without `id` they describe the boat to compare; with `id` they filter its peers as search_boats would. Only boats open at least one week are compared. `similar_pct` is how alike a peer is: the specs it shares, averaged with `overlap_pct` (the share of the boat's open weeks the peer is open too) when there is a boat. With `id`, `anchor.price` is the boat's weekly figures, a peer's `price` is its figure minus the boat's (its own in the weeks listed in `absolute_weeks`), and a peer carries its `region`, `city`, `same` (the fields it shares with the boat) and only the specs that differ, as signed deltas; without `id` every peer carries its own specs and figures. null = not sellable that week; `weeks` gives each check-in date. Use when someone asks how a boat compares with others nearby on price, size or age — an operator benchmarking their own boat included. For what is better or worse about one boat, use get_boat_standouts.

berths.description: Berths: without id the number to match, with id the minimum.

boat_type.description: Without id: the boat type (required with country).

cabins.description: Cabins: without id the number to match; with id the minimum guest cabins, crew cabins not counted (as search_boats).

city.description: Without id, optional: city or town, e.g. Split.

country.description: Without id: ISO country code, e.g. HR (required with boat_type).

guests.description: Guests: without id the number to match, with id the minimum.

id.description: Boat id from search_boats or get_boat_details — copy it verbatim. Omit to describe a boat by its specs.

lock.description: With id: keep only peers the same as the boat in these fields — the fields a peer's `same` lists.

makemodel.description: Make and/or model as the guest said it, e.g. "Lagoon 42", "Bali".

region.description: Without id, optional: sailing region, e.g. Dalmatia.

toilets.description: Toilets: without id the number to match, with id the minimum.

name: compare_boat
title: Compare a Boat With Similar Boats
